data.narrative:
Castelion is a Series C defense and security company founded by Bryon Hargis, Sean Pitt, and Andrew Kreitz. The company has raised $1.25B in equity to date ($100M Series A, $350M Series B, $800M Series C) plus a $250M credit facility. The comparable universe consists of 15 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Stark Defence, Neros, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, with peer valuations ranging from $300M to $9.2B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $1.0B Series B post-money valuation and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across the 15-company set yields $2.2B, consistent with the distribution spanning from $300M to $9.2B. These methods triangulate to a low of $1.4B, median of $1.9B, and high of $2.5B.

The current stated valuation of $13B sits substantially above both triangulated methods, suggesting significant asymmetry between founder expectations and market-derived benchmarks. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory not provided in this dataset, as well as the terminal stage and market dynamics driving the upper quartile peers (Saronic at $9.2B, Quantum-Systems at $8.0B).
